The warm amber glow illuminates the table surface and casts a dim, enveloping warmth on the surrounding area. In the background, a large sofa in smooth warm greige upholstery is partially visible with an oversized ribbed ivory cushion leaning against the back. Curtain panels in warm taupe hang in the far background. A corner of a coffee table book is barely visible at the lower left foreground. The palette is entirely warm neutral — walnut, amber, taupe feather, brass, and greige upholstery. The atmosphere is cozy, romantic, and softly theatrical.
